Deliver ONE updated square job mate icon. Preserve image 1's exact single-letter abstract j geometry: one small circular dot above a single vertical stem with rounded top-left and bottom-right, straight upper-right and lower-left edges. Preserve the rounded-square tile shape, internal proportions, spacing, and optical centering. No extra symbols, no second figure, no text.
Recolor the tile with a restrained, beautifully smooth ima-inspired fresh MINT-GREEN to LIME/YELLOW-GREEN gradient. Soft pale mint #D0F7E4 at top left, clean fresh green #85DF77 around lower left/center, luminous lime-yellow #D2EB35 toward bottom right. Keep the gradient elegant and airy, no teal, cyan or blue. Recolor the inner j dot and stem to solid near-black #111111 so they contrast crisply with the light green tile, as ima's black-on-green palette does. This is a professional software identity, not a playful character.
The background OUTSIDE the rounded square is pure opaque white #FFFFFF with small even margins. The tile is a flat 2D shape with color gradient only: NO cast shadow, NO 3D, NO bevel, NO shiny highlights, NO texture, NO grain, NO mockup, no labels. Smooth vector-like contours. Square composition, tile fills about 84-88% of canvas.
